dataset_description: CUSTOM TRIEVO TEST DATA - Isolated clinical test cases for emergency room triage evaluation. Strictly held out from training.

cases.text: Patient presents with acute retrosternal chest pain radiating to left arm with diaphoresis.
Patient has severe shortness of breath, bilateral wheezing, and productive cough for 3 days.
Male with persistent high grade fever, retro-orbital headache, and severe myalgia suspicious for dengue fever.
Patient with chronic hemoptysis, night sweats, significant weight loss, and suspected pulmonary tuberculosis.
Young female with acute severe lower right quadrant abdominal pain, nausea, and vomiting.
Driver involved in road traffic accident presents with blunt chest trauma, rib fractures, and respiratory distress.
Elderly male on metoprolol and aspirin reports bradycardia and dizziness.
Sudden onset severe occipital headache described as worst headache of life with neck stiffness.
High spiking fevers with rigors, thrombocytopenia, and petechial rash observed following travel.
Elderly woman fell sustaining suspected femoral neck fracture and acute severe hip pain.
Child presenting with acute asthma exacerbation, gasping, and intercostal retractions.
Patient has severe acute chest pain for 3 days but denies shortness of breath; treated with nitroglycerin.
